desc: Ideate and select the $O(MAX)$ approach: Precompute frequencies, then iterate $x$ to count pairs summing to $S$, and multiply by $f(S)$.
Compute the frequency array `cnt` for values in $A$.
Precompute the function $f(S)$ for all $S$ from 1 to $MAX\_SUM$ using a linear sieve (if $S$ is even, $f(S) = f(S/2)$; else $f(S) = S$).
Calculate pairs summing to $2x$: add `cnt[x] * (cnt[x] + 1) // 2` to total.
Calculate pairs summing to $S > 2x$: add `cnt[x] * cnt[S-x] * f(S)` to total.
